lines.1: It was exactly eleven at night.
lines.2: Matsukasa, the city that never sleeps--
lines.3: Where did all these people come from, and where did they disappear to?
lines.4: Tonight, like every night, I walked alone.
lines.7: I did see other Ryuumeikan students out having fun after dark.
lines.8: But I was here every day.
lines.9: I suppose it couldn't be helped that people talked.
lines.10: Anyway, I sat down on the secluded bench I'd found the other day.
lines.12: This was a great spot, difficult for other people to find.
lines.13: It was also close to a vending machine that sold my favorite tea.
lines.14: Once I sat on the bench, I sank into my own world.
lines.15: I could hear a street musician playing.
lines.16: The music was rough around the edges, but I liked it. It was perfect for thinking.
lines.19: I had inherited my mother's inability to gain weight, but my appetite had been growing lately.
lines.21: I'd meant to think seriously about my future, and instead my first concern was a late-night snack.
lines.22: Apparently, I was more materialistic than I thought.
lines.24: 「The Princess is glamorous, but Yashi has that straightforward beauty going for her.」
lines.26: 「With a face that pretty, of course. That stuck-up attitude is cheeky, but I can forgive it when I know she'll be mine someday.」
lines.27: 「Though if Yashi were ugly and talked that harshly, I'd kill her on behalf of every man in the world.」
lines.28: 「But even with that foul mouth, she's surprisingly serious about things.」
lines.29: 「Tch. Don't go praising Coconut. She's a bad girl. I bet she shakes down elementary-school kids when no one's looking.」
lines.30: 「No, she's diligent when she's working. Even the Princess praised her.」
lines.31: 「I mean, if she couldn't even do what she was told in her condition, she'd just be completely useless.」
lines.32: 「That's true. Though there are people like that.」
lines.33: 「Yeah. People like that are the worst.」
lines.34: 「Why is everyone looking at me? Did you fall for me? Come on, this is awkward...」
